control.title: Legal and regulatory requirements register
control.description: Maintain a register of applicable laws, regulations and contractual obligations (DPDP, CERT-In, IT Act, sector rules, customer contracts) and of software licences.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
